source.ref: fixed by b5dcdb3 (stray plugin) and eadf263 (exit code order)

rationale: A sed edit added a function to the built-in plugin list, and the new incomplete-review check sits after the blocking return, so both bugs are visible in the diff.

expect.concern: coverageGaps is a helper function, not a plugin, yet it was added to BUILTIN_PLUGINS; it type-checks because functions have a name, and registers nothing.
A blocking verdict returns exit 1 before the new coverage check, so a review that left files unreviewed exits 1 instead of 3, and the action lets 1 pass by default.
